tpms.when: 2021 with the Tire Pressure Monitor reset in iDrive
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label in the driver's door opening.
On the iDrive screen, open My Vehicle, then Vehicle status, then Tire Pressure Monitor.
Start the engine but stay parked.
Drive off. The wheels show gray while the reset runs, and it finishes on its own after several minutes of driving.
When the wheels turn green, the reset is done.
tpms.note: Reset after a tire or wheel change or any pressure adjustment. Gray wheels on the status screen can also mean a system fault; if they stay gray, have it checked.

notes: Only the 2021 owner's manual was checked step by step for this model.
